name: research-skills
description: Zotero, OpenAlex, Semantic Scholar and arXiv tooling for systematic literature reviews.
long_description:
Exposes this repo's skill CLIs as MCP tools over stdio: Zotero library operations (collections, items, search, export, tagging, PRISMA counts), OpenAlex and Semantic Scholar lookups and citation snowballing, arXiv query sizing and import, duplicate merge preparation, and PDF-to-text extraction.

API keys are entered once at install and held by the host's secure credential storage, rather than being pasted into project instructions where they would sit in every session's system prompt. On macOS and Linux the server also falls back to harvesting keys from your login shell, so an existing ~/.zshrc setup keeps working and any field left blank here defers to it.

tools.name: zotero
tools.description: Zotero library: collections, items, count, search, export, tag-add, create-items, prisma, trace, superseded

tools.name: openalex
tools.description: OpenAlex: work, abstract, enrich, search, cites, references

tools.name: semantic_scholar
tools.description: Semantic Scholar: snowball, search, bulk, paper, citations, references, batch

tools.name: zotero_merge_prep
tools.description: Prepare duplicate Zotero records for merging: scan, find, prep

tools.name: zotero_pdf_to_text
tools.description: Extract PDF attachments to TXT child attachments (requires pdftotext on PATH)

tools.name: arxiv_fetch
tools.description: arXiv query to a Zotero create-items plan

tools.name: arxiv_count
tools.description: Size an arXiv query before fetching

zotero_library_id.title: Zotero library ID
zotero_library_id.description: Numeric ID of the group or user library, e.g. 6505702. Not a secret.

zotero_api_key_ro.title: Zotero API key (read-only)
zotero_api_key_ro.description: Read-only key. Used for every read path; keeping reads on a separate key limits the blast radius if it leaks.

zotero_api_key_rw.title: Zotero API key (read-write)
zotero_api_key_rw.description: Optional. Only needed for writes (tag-add, create-items). Leave blank to keep this install read-only.

openalex_mailto.title: OpenAlex contact email
openalex_mailto.description: Puts you in OpenAlex's polite pool. Without it, requests are throttled to roughly 100/day. Not a secret.

openalex_api_key.title: OpenAlex API key
openalex_api_key.description: Optional. Only if you have a premium key.

semantic_scholar_api_key.title: Semantic Scholar API key
semantic_scholar_api_key.description: Optional but strongly recommended: the anonymous pool is shared and returns 429s under snowballing.

exa_api_key.title: Exa API key
exa_api_key.description: Optional. Only used if an Exa-backed skill is present.
